rationale: Compound on the EMA best by shifting exact-export precision within the low-rank bigram tail: force `bigram_in.weight` onto the real int8 path, keep the directly logit-facing `bigram_out.weight` plus output scalars in fp32, and keep EMA tracking on the whole output tail. The hypothesis is that final exact `int8+zlib` score cares more about precision at the last projection than at the input factor, and this swap should stay under the 16 MB cap while targeting the compressed-roundtrip objective directly.
title: Reallocate Bigram Tail Precision Toward Output Projection
